rationale: CanvasWidget::paint opens its per-canvas offscreen layer only when the recorded stream reads its backdrop (clearRect, putImageData, or a composite operation other than source-over), or when a shader effect, native painter or native GPU texture is present; every other stream paints under a plain save plus the same bounds clip, which is pixel-identical because source-over is associative. The retained-ui-kernel touch is canvas_widget.hpp (add_command flags backdrop-reading commands on the shared recorded stream; clear_commands resets the flag) and canvas_widget.cpp (the layer decision). It is a Pulp render-cost decision over Pulp's own recorded Canvas2D stream with no counterpart framework behaviour to backport, so it is recorded pulp-only.
